patient_count: dynamic; read from the case manifest and downstream data
primary_regions: high confidence plus independently validated stable medium confidence
same_frequency_handling: background or brightness same-frequency is a warning and forces medium confidence; it is not exclusion by itself
patient_eligibility: at least one eligible posterior-wall region
regional_aggregation: equal mean over available cervical, middle, and fundal posterior regions
nonlinearity: restricted cubic spline with training-sample P10/P50/P90 knots
